The camera rapidly pulls back to reveal the natural landscape. Simultaneously, the weasel's body begins to glow and morph, its fur dissolving into flowing hair and its limbs elongating into graceful human arms. The camera executes a swift, dynamic rotation around the transforming figure, blurring the background into a swirl of green and blue. As the transformation completes, the camera thrusts forward rapidly into a medium shot of a beautiful young woman in a traditional yellow hanfu, standing elegantly in a classical Chinese pavilion. The transition is fluid, blending the wild energy of nature with the serene grace of the human form.
